_comment: Sealed inventory of checkpoint-generated reds. Every row is a failure whose only operand is a generated build output, so no source-plane edit can close it. Paired with SEALED_RED_IDENTITIES in red-inventory-gate.mjs: edit both or the gate fails. Liveness is proven by red-inventory-gate.mjs --reconcile against a real census run, never by --check alone.

rows.test: rottay artifact is a generated build output matches the committed artifact byte-for-byte (regenerate-and-diff)
rows.failureShape: to be '/* GENERATED — do not edit */
rows.reason: the committed rottay artifact no longer equals what the authored Theme renders; only a regeneration wave can close it
